title: POS till frozen – soft and hard reboot
body:
## When to use
The till screen does not respond to touch or the scanner.

## Steps
1. Park the open basket and ask the customer to wait.
2. Hold the **power button** for 5 seconds until the screen goes dark.
3. Wait 30 seconds, power on and sign in with your POS PIN.
4. Still frozen? Unplug the till for **60 seconds** (hard reboot).

## Still not fixed
Ask **Stitch** – it can check the till heartbeat and open a ticket with the steps you already tried.

pt.title: Caixa POS bloqueada – reinício simples e completo
pt.body:
## Quando usar
O ecrã da caixa não responde ao toque nem ao leitor.

## Passos
1. Suspenda a venda em curso e peça ao cliente para aguardar.
2. Mantenha o **botão de energia** premido 5 segundos até o ecrã apagar.
3. Aguarde 30 segundos, ligue e inicie sessão com o seu PIN.
4. Continua bloqueada? Desligue a caixa da corrente durante **60 segundos**.

## Ainda sem solução
Pergunte ao **Stitch** – verifica o estado da caixa e abre um pedido com os passos já feitos.

title: Card reader error E-204 "host not reachable"
body:
## What it means
`E-204` – the reader cannot reach the payment host.

## Steps
1. Check the outage banner at the top of the portal. If your store is affected, switch the router to **LTE**.
2. On the reader: Settings → Payments → **Re-pair**.
3. Run a 0.01 test transaction and void it.

pt.title: Erro E-204 no terminal de pagamento "host não acessível"
pt.body:
## O que significa
`E-204` – o terminal não consegue contactar o servidor de pagamentos.

## Passos
1. Veja o aviso de falha no topo do portal. Se a sua loja estiver afetada, mude o router para **LTE**.
2. No terminal: Definições → Pagamentos → **Emparelhar**.
3. Faça uma transação de teste de 0,01 e anule-a.

title: Stockroom Wi-Fi access point – power-cycle
body:
## Steps
1. Find the AP on the stockroom ceiling (white disc, label **AP-STOCK**).
2. In the comms cabinet, unplug the cable on switch port **24** for 10 seconds, then plug it back in.
3. Wait 3 minutes for the light to turn **green**.
4. Tell Stitch or reply on your ticket that it was power-cycled.

title: iPad replacement policy
body:
## Policy
- **1 replacement per store per 90 days** is approved automatically.
- Further requests go to **Security Review** with a photo of the device and its serial label.
- Replacements arrive **pre-enrolled**; return the damaged iPad with the prepaid label within 14 days.

pt.title: Política de substituição de iPads
pt.body:
## Política
- **1 substituição por loja a cada 90 dias** é aprovada automaticamente.
- Pedidos adicionais seguem para **Security Review** com foto do equipamento e da etiqueta do n.º de série.
- Os iPads chegam **pré-configurados**; devolva o equipamento danificado com a etiqueta pré-paga em 14 dias.

title: Password reset and account unlock
body:
## Locked out?
After 5 failed attempts your account locks for 30 minutes.

## Fastest fix
1. Ask **Stitch** to unlock your account.
2. Stitch sends a **6-digit code** by SMS to your registered mobile.
3. Enter the code – your account is unlocked, or you get a reset link.

Never share your password or one-time code.

title: Network outages – how we communicate
body:
## During an outage
- A **red banner** appears on every portal page for affected stores.
- Calls to Store IT hear a known-outage message and are linked to the major incident automatically.
- Updates every **15 minutes** by SMS to store managers.

## Keep trading
Switch the router to **LTE** if your store has LTE backup. Card payments continue; gift cards are offline.

title: Not IT? Facilities, HR and visual merchandising
body:
## Who handles what
- Roller shutters, lighting, HVAC, fitting rooms: **Facilities**.
- Rota and pay: **Workday** self-service.
- Windows, fixtures and mannequins: **Visual Merchandising**.

Stitch routes these automatically so they never wait in the IT queue.
